raw_retention: All original API responses/full XML ignored and preserved locally; original bytes unavailable in a clean Git-only checkout. Source URLs in receipts may retrieve changed versions, not guaranteed byte recovery.
export_scope: Compact evaluated method excerpts, source hashes, query receipts and dispositions only. No full or compact-all-returned bibliographic catalogue export.
reused_sources: Read-only external/worktree cache pointers and hashes in bindings are not raw portability guarantees; prior worker freezes remain immutable.
recovery: Recover exact raws from preserved authorized cache/archive and verify hashes; otherwise query same ordinary official URLs and record dated version differences. Do not infer identical bytes or revive unanswered outcomes.
